description: This file defines an abstract class for menu actions within the OFBiz framework, including nested classes for handling 'set' actions that manipulate widget context and session/application attributes.

classes.name: ModelMenuAction
classes.description: Abstract class representing menu actions in the widget model, including static methods for reading subactions and a nested class for handling 'set' actions.

classes.name: ModelMenuAction.SetField
classes.description: Represents the <set> element syntax in widget configuration, allowing for setting widget context or session/application attributes with flexible typing and expansion.

methods.name: readSubActions
methods.description: Reads sub-action elements from a parent XML element and returns a list of corresponding ModelAction instances.
